title: The canonical chart object comparison satisfies the one-model cocycle
statement: For three affine coordinates [def-pc-affine-coordinate-comparison-data], composable commuting squares, and one K-flat module complex M, the canonical chart object comparisons [lem-pc-affine-coordinate-derived-comparison] compose with scalar reassociation, derived pullback of the first comparison, the fixed perfectHomComposition, and equality transport exactly as in the parent composition law at a single object. No second label or natural-family existence statement occurs in this lemma.

source.place: Tag 0D5S derived-pullback composition universal property, Tag 08DW(2) canonical affine comparison, and Tag 06Y1 scalar-extension preservation.

proof.text: Substitute the equalities of the composite ring and scheme maps. K-flatness of the original model and its scalar extension makes the three fixed counits invertible. The homotopy model comparison law and the fixed counit composition law are the two inputs of the generic inverse-counit composition calculation.

Apply counitComparisonComposition with the three concrete homotopy models. Then apply conjugateComparisonComposition using the supplied chart isomorphisms; their naturality with scalar reassociation supplies its chart hypothesis. The equality-transport factors after substitution are identities.
